subject: Your First Assignment — Operation Zero
body:
Welcome to the department, Detective.

Your first case: Danny Cole, a stockroom clerk at Third & Main Pawn & Loan, didn't come home after closing up alone last night. His car is still parked outside the shop.

This one's a good place to start. Review the evidence we've logged from the scene, then follow it wherever it leads — Evidence Database, Messenger, City Map, CCTV, Forensics, and the Criminal Database are all at your disposal. When you're confident you know what happened, build your case on the Investigation Board and submit your resolution.

Take your time. Everyone starts somewhere.

— Captain Morgan
Chief of Detectives, CID
